# Test fixture images

Used only by automated tests. All files were downloaded from Wikimedia Commons on 2026-10-23 and
downscaled to 640 px wide (JPEG q85). Licences were read from each file's Commons `LicenseShortName`.

| File | Source | Licence | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `face_sunita_williams.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sunita_Williams.jpg | Public domain (NASA) | one face; slight turn |
| `face_victor_glover.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Victor_J._Glover_official_portrait.jpg | Public domain (NASA) | one face, frontal |
| `face_raja_chari.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Raja_Chari_official_portrait.jpg | Public domain (NASA) | one face, frontal |
| `face_sunita_williams_2018.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sunita_Williams_in_2018.jpg (official NASA portrait, 2018-07-31; added 2026-10-27, 640 px from the 960 px Commons thumbnail) | Public domain (NASA) | identity: same person as `face_sunita_williams.jpg`, different photo session |
| `face_victor_glover_2018.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Victor_J._Glover_in_2018.jpg (official NASA portrait, 2018-07-31; added 2026-10-27, 640 px from the 960 px Commons thumbnail) | Public domain (NASA) | identity: same person as `face_victor_glover.jpg`, different photo session |
| `head_profiles_two_people.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mark_and_Scott_Kelly_at_the_Johnson_Space_Center,_Houston_Texas_-_profile.jpg | Public domain (NASA) | two faces in profile (head pose +/-90) |
| `head_turned_texting.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Woman_texting_on_a_smartphone.jpg | CC0 | turned head (head pose) |
| `phone_hand_closeup.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Smartphone_Use.jpg | CC0 | phone, no face |
| `phone_woman_holding.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Woman_holding_cell_phone_3236059.jpg | CC0 | phone in hand |
| `phone_man_laptop.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Man_with_smartphone_and_laptop_(Unsplash).jpg | CC0 | phone next to a laptop |

NASA's media guidelines ask that images not be used to imply endorsement. None of these files are used in the
product UI, and they must not be presented as students.
